title: Sorcerer With A Minigun (v50)
description: Hurl fireballs, summon skeletal minions, and battle through waves of enemies in this dark fantasy arena. Full HP restored at start of each wave.
prompt:
make the following changes

1. remove the skeleton archer from the shop and clean up any code related to this. 

2. remove the token cooldown so they don't disappear off the map. 

3.• Create a new ultimate Sorcerer weapon called "The Annihilator!".

• The Annihilator is the final weapon upgrade and should be visually larger and more intimidating than the Minigun.

• Its appearance should combine elements of both the Minigun and Railgun, creating a massive endgame weapon that looks powerful and over-engineered.

• Fires fully charged Railgun shots continuously while the fire button is held.

• No charge-up time is required before firing.

• Each shot should behave exactly like a fully charged Railgun blast.

• The weapon should feel extremely powerful and serve as the ultimate Sorcerer weapon.

• Add a heat meter instead of a charge meter.

• Heat increases continuously while firing.

• The weapon can only be fired continuously for a short period before overheating.

• When overheated, the weapon cannot be fired.

• The player must stop firing and wait for the weapon to cool down before firing again.

• Heat gradually decreases while not firing.

• Add clear visual and UI feedback for heat level and overheating state.

• The Annihilator should only appear in the shop after the player has completely maxed every available upgrade.

• Do not hardcode specific upgrade names or levels.

• The unlock check must dynamically verify that every upgrade in the upgrade system has reached its maximum level.

• This must continue to work automatically if new upgrades are added in the future.

• Once all upgrades are fully maxed, The Annihilator becomes available for purchase as the final ultimate upgrade.

• The Annihilator should feel like the ultimate endgame reward for fully completing a build.

• It should be dramatically stronger than both the Minigun and Railgun while remaining balanced by the overheating mechanic.

add a 3rd option next to the current options for weapon selection, this will be number 3 once purchased.

make the cost of this weapon 1000 tokens.
